remarks: Imagine waking up in the heart of downtown Edmonton, where the city is right outside your door and your car becomes optional. Welcome to Cambridge Lofts—a place where convenience, affordability, and an exciting urban lifestyle come together. Freshly painted and featuring newer appliances, this home is an ideal opportunity for the first-time buyer ready to stop renting, the downsizer looking for simplicity, the investor seeking a great location, or the student wanting to be close to everything. With direct access to the LRT, getting around the city is effortless. Spend your evenings enjoying dinner and drinks at nearby restaurants and pubs, catch a game or concert at Rogers Place, browse the shops, visit the library, or take a stroll through the beautiful river valley. The iconic Hotel Macdonald is just a short walk away, adding to the charm of this incredible downtown location. And with a secure building and the opportunity to own for potentially less than the cost of renting. (id:67522)
